text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to an organisation. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong, whether it is financial loss, technical failure or safety issues. Once risks are known, mitigation strategies can reduce their impact or make them less likely to happen. For example, a company might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so the business knows exactly what to do if a problem occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time, and regular reviews help ensure that plans stay effective and up to date.
